cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Content Writer position at Unknown. With a solid foundation in digital marketing and a focus on creating engaging, SEO-optimized content, my skills and experience directly align with the responsibilities outlined in your job description.

In my role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I am responsible for owning on-page SEO, which includes comprehensive keyword research and writing keyword-targeted blog content for diverse client websites. This involves crafting clear marketing copy, preparing well-structured drafts using Content Management Systems like WordPress, and ensuring the content is optimized for search engines to drive organic traffic. My work also involves tracking site performance with analytics tools to inform content strategy and decisions.

My experience extends to the technical aspects of content visibility. Through my personal project, mirook.com, I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site, implemented structured data and entity optimization, and conducted technical SEO/GEO audits. This project also involved social media integration, demonstrating my ability to promote content across various platforms.

I possess excellent writing and editing skills in English, honed through creating content for clients and managing my own projects. I am adept at researching industry-related topics and translating findings into compelling articles. While working remotely, I have effectively managed client deliverables, underscoring my ability to meet deadlines and work collaboratively, as well as coordinate content needs for various stakeholders. I am eager to apply my expertise to Unknown’s content initiatives.

Thank you for considering my application. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to contribute to your team and would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills and experience can benefit your organization.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
